# Quotes

Passages from sources, each with a locator and the level at which it was checked. `Checked to` describes this reading, not the strength of the claim it supports: a passage copied from a secondary summary is `secondary` however good the argument resting on it. Every quotation whose source text is reachable is verified word for word by `scripts/check-quote-fidelity.mjs`.
